main.text.signUpNowtoSaveOurOcean: Sign Up Now to Save Our Ocean
main.text.signUpNowtoSaveOurOceanDes: Sign up now to participate in our beta tests! By submitting your artworks in our NFT art events, you can receive royalties from the proceeds of your NFTs while the marine conservation organizations that you support can be funded.
main.text.uncoverScarcityWithAIDes: 95% of our ocean is unexplored. Scientists use AI to understand those areas, identifying many unique marine life hidden deeply in the sea. In the Mindful Ocean Metaverse, we use AI to analyze the scarcity of the artworks submitted by our users, uncovering their hidden creativity.
main.text.raiseFundsforMarineConservatio: By hosting inclusive, engaging, and meaningful community NFT art events in the Mindful Ocean Metaverse, our goal is to raise funds for marine conservation organizations, scientists, and artists to save our ocean.

home.banner.text1: 90% of marine species are at risk of extinction?
home.part1.title1: Mindful Ocean Metaverse aims at answering the following questions.
home.part1.text1: 1. How can we cultivate empathy to save marine life?
home.part1.text2: 2. How can we empower more people to support ocean conservation?
home.part2.text1: Mindful Ocean Metaverse is a community art project with a mission to save our ocean. We use blockchain, AI, and AR technology to empower anyone to take part in ocean conservation by making art. Our NFT art creation events nurture mindfulness and promote creativity, enabling anyone to easily create NFT artworks that simulate marine life in a co-created virtual space - the Mindful Ocean Metaverse.
home.part3.title1: How can we save our ocean by making art?
home.part3.text1: We believe art-making can cultivate mindfulness, empathy, and creativity, which can improve our well-being, empower us to make better life-changing decisions, and facilitate the development of innovative solutions for ocean conservation. Our community art project aims at nurturing peoples' empathy towards marine life, and raising funds to carry out urgent actions that can save our ocean.
home.part4.title1: The 6 phases of Mindful Ocean art-making event
home.part4.subText1: In each event, we feature a specific marine animal, and provide all users with the same coloring template in our app. Users are invited to participate in a creative challenge, in which they can use the provided template to design the outlook of the marine animal, and submit their unique designs to the event.
home.part4.subText2: On our website, users can select a submitted artwork, and turn it into a Mindful Ocean Mint Pass. At the end of the event, each Mint Pass can be used to redeem a Mindful Ocean NFT, which contains the submitted artwork and its metadata.
home.part4.subText3: Once we have received all the submitted artwork in an event, we will compute a score for each artwork using AI. Each artwork will be organized into clusters, while each cluster will be further organized into superclusters. The total number of artworks in the cluster and supercluster that a specific artwork belongs to will be used to derive a score that can represent the scarcity of the artwork authentically. We name this score Authentic Scarcity.
home.part4.subText4: After the AI analysis is completed, we will embed each artwork alongside metadata like Authentic Scarcity, Cluster ID, and Cluster Size into a Mindful Ocean NFT. Owners of the Mindful Ocean Mint Pass can then burn their Mindful Ocean Mint Pass to redeem the Mindful Ocean NFT.
home.part4.subText5: In our app, users can unlock the AR Metaverse, a co-created virtual space where users can collect Mindful Ocean NFTs, play with the simulated marine life using hand gestures, and interact with other users. Our AR Metaverse is powered by our partner Auki Labs’ cutting-edge AR technology.
home.part4.subText6: A donation will be made to support organizations or individuals who contribute to ocean conservation. The amount of the donation will be at least 50% and up to 100% of the net revenue generated from each event. We aim at building a Web 3 community and become a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO). In the future, a mechanism to allow our community members to govern the details of the donations will be developed.
home.part5.title1: How can we support more people to make art and save our ocean?
home.part5.title2: Proceeds generated from this project will be used in the following major areas:
home.part5.subText1: To support organizations active in ocean conservation, sustainability education, and art education to carry out their projects.
home.part5.subText2: To encourage more people to make art.
